picks.name: Byron the Aquarius
picks.bio: Already in your library. "ORGASMANIA" (July 30, 2026) returns to French label Skylax Records -- a deeper, freer, more unpredictable four-track statement where jazz instinct meets raw machine funk, opening with the spiritual, meditative "Back 2 Zion (Tomorrow)."
picks.why_listen: Cultured, heady deep house rooted in the Detroit lineage but never confined by it -- house music as expression rather than format, from an artist already in your rotation.

picks.name: AFRIK-N-SOUL
picks.source_note: New artist discovery: self-released. Similar soulful house territory to your Byron the Aquarius and Session Victim picks.
picks.bio: "AFRIK-N-SOUL Sept 2026 Release" (September 3, 2026) is a six-track set of soulful house edits and reworks, including vocal cuts and a Tevin Campbell-sampling flip.
picks.why_listen: Warm, vocal-driven soulful house -- a good source of feel-good grooves and edits for a mid-set stretch.
